source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Leviticus 23–25. The exact original XML records include all five source annotations, including the written not and read has a wall at 25:30; no numbering shift occurs in this batch.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the exact date and Passover name; twilight renders between the evenings with its timing uncertainty noted.
Distinguishes work of service from the broader no-work prohibition in verse 3.
Preserves land as divine gift and the initial harvest presentation; sheaf is the selected sense of omer, noted against a measured grain portion.
Keeps both wave actions, acceptance for the people, and the unresolved calendar reference to the Sabbath.
Retains Hebrew Sabbaths while unfolding the complete-period requirement in readable English; note preserves calendar disagreement.
Preserves two discrete breads and the deliberately leavened preparation; the quantity is not incorrectly assigned to each loaf.
Keeps the repeated two-lamb phrase and pronoun without inventing a physical waving procedure or silently resolving every referent.
Preserves remembrance and teruah without inserting a named trumpet or shofar that this verse does not specify.
Keeps the date and established deny-yourselves idiom rather than reducing the Hebrew to an explicit fasting rule.
Retains the broader work ban and repeated atonement purpose, avoiding an ordinary-work limitation.
Preserves cut-off language without assigning its mechanism, and keeps the self-denial condition distinct from work.
Makes the divine first-person agent explicit and preserves destroy as distinct from the preceding passive cut off.
Unfolds evening-to-evening timing while preserving the ninth-evening start and tenth-day designation in verse 27.
Preserves the eighth-day gathering in addition to the seven festival days and retains atseret without assuming a modern observance.
Retains fruit as written rather than replacing it with branches; does not specify citron or myrtle or turn the list into booth-building instructions.
Preserves native-born scope rather than adding resident foreigners; sentence continues across the verse label into its purpose.
